decisions.evidence: Independently reviewed the complete current Definition, twelve dependencies and sole TikZ diagram. Git HEAD raw SHA256 91445397e641f135d606ab0baa80f05177e0661cbeef34c0a962f79be92700fd equals pre-reader snapshot; current raw SHA256 228122cb593da58d3b874a03a7157ab1724e897c608abfb56de73d8a5fcc9807 equals post-reader snapshot. The original diagram misrepresents depth 1/2. Corrected diagram is explicitly for N>=3, with middle updates 1 through N-2, exact N=3 specialization and one/two-layer caveats. Borel-domain, proximal existence and finite strict-branch AD claims satisfy their actual prerequisites. All three item consumers use the preserved recursion; no further mathematical repair is necessary. Synchronized owning manifest and in-batch consumer citations. Full evidence and source-reading limits in report.

The original unchanged pre/post reader carrier (raw SHA256 8f9743d2110dbf12c285469fcda6de6db82e1f9a0666ac8b81b57c423d57cb9a) allows training pairs outside the partial deployment domain, making its displayed risk undefined. A valid architecture with first block restricted to a=1 fails at training input a=2. Repaired Statement and Given specify a common nonempty Borel E contained in all compared deployment domains, training and shifted inputs in E, signal targets in X, and test laws on E x X. Borel restrictions and continuous squared loss give a valid extended nonnegative risk. All eight proof steps and six suppliers independently checked; explicit full-domain scalar witness, divergence and finite-derivative counterexamples remain sound. No item consumes the proposition; assigned page placement requires no change. Updated manifest, contract, risk review and dependency records.
